messages.subject: Adriana | Mining & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations and International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Adriana,

Your executive-search work across Industrial & Manufacturing and Energy & Natural Resources, together with your earlier mining-sector experience, makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where resource-sector leadership depends on government relations, ESG and stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. I work across ministries, regulators, communities and technical functions to translate external obligations into accountable execution.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in mining, metals, energy, infrastructure and industrial businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Latin America, the Middle East, Europe and other global assignments.

I have attached an EMA Partners-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
